review_notes: I read the whole file and the related ExtChartAt.lean helpers (MeasurableSet.image_extChartAt, IsOpen.measurableSet_image_extChartAt_source_inter). I compared the proofs of chartRiemannianVolume_apply, setLIntegral_chartRiemannianVolume, the positivity theorem and the overlap theorem. The overlap proof and the positivity proof mostly use different reasoning, so I did not report them. I could not compile anything, so the proposed rewrite is untested. The final `simpa` step in particular depends on the exact Mathlib lemma names for the constant-1 set integral and on the shape of `mul_one` in ℝ≥0∞.

findings.problem: The two theorems repeat the same transfer argument. Each unfolds `chartRiemannianVolume` as map ∘ comap ∘ withDensity. Each uses the measurable embedding `measurableEmbedding_extChartAt_restrict` and `Set.image_domRestrict` to identify the image with `e '' (s ∩ e.source)`. Each proves that this image is measurable, with a copy-pasted `rw [← hset/himage]; exact ….measurableSet_image.mpr (hs.preimage measurable_subtype_coe)` block. Each replaces `d.toFun` by `ofReal (chartVolumeDensity …)` on the target via `eq_on_target`. The `φ`-version is strictly more general. Taking `φ = fun _ ↦ 1` gives the `_apply` statement, since `∫⁻ x in s, 1 ∂μ = μ s` and `ofReal _ * 1 = ofReal _`. The unit-test-sized `_apply` proof is therefore a second copy of the hardest part of the other proof. Any change to the definition, such as the density data or the comap/map structure, must be repaired in both.
findings.proposed_change:
Put `setLIntegral_chartRiemannianVolume` first. Its proof does not use `_apply`, so the order can change. Then derive `chartRiemannianVolume_apply` from it:

```lean
theorem chartRiemannianVolume_apply ... (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    chartRiemannianVolume (I := I) α s = ∫⁻ y in (extChartAt I α) '' (s ∩ (extChartAt I α).source),
      ENNReal.ofReal (chartVolumeDensity (I := I) α ((extChartAt I α).symm y)) ∂(Module.finBasis ℝ E).addHaar := by
  simpa only [mul_one, setLIntegral_one] using
    setLIntegral_chartRiemannianVolume (I := I) α hs (fun _ ↦ 1)
```

The existing helper `MeasurableSet.image_extChartAt` can also replace the hand-built measurability block at lines 132–135 and 160–162. Apply it to `hs.inter (isOpen_extChartAt_source α).measurableSet` with `inter_subset_right`, as ExtChartAt.lean line 282 already does. The `htarget` and `eq_on_target` congruence can be a single private `EqOn`-style lemma. The positivity theorem's `heq` (lines 205–213) and the proofs at lines 136–140, 175–178 would use it.
findings.benefit: This removes one of two parallel copies of the map/comap/withDensity unfolding. Only one theorem carries the delicate embedding and `domRestrict` bookkeeping, and the basic evaluation formula becomes a short corollary. The repeated measurability and `eq_on_target` blocks shrink to existing API, so the file is shorter and easier to maintain.
